output.diagnosis: Payer notes state Orbit Print & Media wants all open bills clubbed and paid together, and will only fix a payment date once a consolidated statement is signed off. The invoice is outstanding and past its due date, but no contact has been made yet and there is no dispute description or payer reply on record. Payment history shows consistently full settlement, though habitually several weeks past terms. The blocker described is a documentation/reconciliation step (a statement of open bills requiring sign-off), not simple silence or ordinary lateness, and there is no unexpired promise phrase to rely on.
output.reasoning: The stated condition for payment is a signed-off consolidated statement covering multiple open bills. Producing and agreeing that statement is account-level work an automated reminder cannot perform, and chasing this single invoice risks cutting across the consolidation the payer has asked for. The receivable is substantial and the payer has a track record of paying in full, so a person should prepare the statement, confirm which bills are in scope, and secure a date. Uncertainty: the note is second-hand and undated, no reply text is present, and it is unclear whether a statement has already been requested or issued, so a human may find the blocker is already partly resolved.
